# DemoCare Multispeciality Hospital — Healthcare Automation API

DemoCare Multispeciality Hospital operates an automated patient communication, triage, and scheduling automation layer compliant with NABH standards and India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.

## Public Services
- Homepage & Patient Consultation Intake: https://democare.hospital/
- System Health & Uptime Probe: https://democare.hospital/health

## Core Capabilities
- Automated Inbound Lead Qualification & OPD Booking
- Clinical Emergency Escalation Guardrails (Chest Pain, Trauma, Severe Bleeding)
- WhatsApp Automated 24h & 3h Reminders & No-Show Recovery
- Cashless Insurance Pre-Verification / TPA Desks
- Live OPD Token Queue Distribution
- Post-Discharge Patient Care & Feedback Triage

## Security & Compliance
- Data Protection: In-memory encryption, zero PHI transmission to third-party ad networks
- Architecture: REST API, SQLite WAL Mode, Node.js Microservices
